title: gain-modulated Mirror context state with frozen synapses
hypothesis: A two-scalar context/gain code over a fixed recurrent reservoir can recover heldout temporal response functions with less per-task state and fewer support sequences than writable per-task recurrent decay updates, while preserving output quality.
physical_object: Eight-channel diagonal linear recurrent reservoir with fixed input weights and decay parameters
mirror_coordinate: Two task coordinates decoded into per-channel readout gains over recurrent hidden state
logical_multiplicity: Sixteen heldout temporal filters implemented by one frozen reservoir plus per-task gain state
controls: native PCA/context-gain state over the same reservoir
independent full readout fit over reservoir channels
task-specific writable recurrent decay vector optimized on support

development.selection_metric: No hyperparameter tuning; validate reservoir dynamics, optimization, byte counting and native control alias only.

world.reservoir: Eight fixed channels h_k[t]=lambda_k*h_k[t-1]+x[t], with world-specific lambdas spanning 0.15 to 0.90
world.task_generation: Teacher readout coefficients a_t=z_t B, with z_t~N(0,I_2) and a world-specific orthonormal B in R^(2x8); training and heldout z are independent
world.training: Estimate train task readouts from 8 sequences of length 64; discover rank-2 context basis only from the 16 training tasks
world.observation: Output y[t]=sum_k a_tk h_k[t] plus Gaussian noise sigma .02; heldout test sequences are independently generated
world.adaptation: Each support sequence is one new context demonstration; fit low-rank code, independent readout, or fast recurrent decays only using support

policy.mirror: Infer two task coordinates on frozen learned rank-2 readout basis and decode eight gains
policy.native_control: Use the same native PCA basis, coordinates, and state update; this is a required exact-alias control
policy.fast_weights: Optimize eight per-task recurrent decay values while keeping the shared scalar readout fixed to one
policy.quality: Heldout temporal output MSE and maximum heldout-task MSE per fresh world
policy.reset: Reset recurrent hidden state and task code between sequences; report cross-task contamination check

storage.authority: Exact serialized inference payload bytes using deterministic little-endian float32 arrays and metadata
paid_objects: fixed reservoir decay and input weights
per-task context coordinates or independent readout
storage.amortization: Charge shared state once across 16 heldout tasks and all per-task states; report per-task amortized bytes
storage.free_state: Only constants fixed in PROTOCOL.json and deterministically regenerated from the seed are free.

report: fast-weight optimizer evaluations and active operations

success_gate: At no more than two support sequences, rank-2 gain state has heldout MSE <= .01 in every fresh world, uses at least 25% fewer actual bytes than writable fast-weight state, and has no cross-task contamination. Mirror-specific attribution additionally requires beating the native PCA/context-gain control.
failure_gate: Quality/reset/byte gate misses, or exact native gain-control alias, fails Mirror-specific attribution. Preserve the useful adaptation and storage comparison separately.
boundaries: Synthetic linear recurrent reservoir only; not a trained RNN, animal behavior, or PA235 reproduction.
Tasks are generated in a known rank-2 readout family; arbitrary recurrent behaviors are not tested.
The fast-weight optimizer is a task-specific recurrent-decay control, not a full learned Hebbian/DeltaNet implementation.
No claim that sixteen context codes are sixteen independent recurrent capacities.
